## Risk review

- [ ] This change contains no secret, token, production credential, or private dataset.
- [ ] New or changed inputs are validated and authorization remains enforced.
- [ ] Import and job changes remain idempotent and tolerate individual-record failures.
- [ ] Data-model changes include a forward migration and a backup/rollback note.
- [ ] New environment variables are documented without real values.
- [ ] User-visible data or classification changes explain their data-quality impact.
- [ ] Deployment changes preserve private database networking and manual deployment.
